UsageQuota.title: UsageQuota
UsageQuota.description: Per-user daily AI usage quota ledger synced between Firestore and local cache mirror.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

dateIso.description: Current quota period date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

architectUsed.description: Number of AI Crosshair Architect calls consumed today.

visionUsed.description: Number of AI Map Screenshot Contrast Analyzer calls consumed today.

coachUsed.description: Number of AI Aim Coach calls consumed today.

bonusGraceCredits.description: Bonus daily grace credits granted (max 3 per day).

graceClaimed.description: Whether the one-time daily +3 grace credit grant has been claimed today.

ecoLiteMode.description: User preference to route cloud requests to the high-efficiency Economy Lite model tier.

fallbackCascadeCount.description: Number of times requests automatically cascaded to Economy Lite or local fallback today.

createdAt.description: Document creation server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/usageQuota/{periodId}.description: Per-user AI usage quota ledger documents (e.g., periodId = 'daily').
